name: Wizard Tower Library
author: voodoo573
description: The round top floor of a wizard tower. Bookshelves line the curved wall, a spiral staircase leads down on the west side, a writing desk sits to the north-east and a bubbling cauldron to the south-east. In the centre, an orb on a pedestal rests on a rug embroidered with a golden circle. 20 x 20 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Round tower library with shelves, ritual rug, desk and stairs.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
